title: On coset-unions gamma is a PRODUCT in mu_{n/gcd}, #lacBad <= n constructively
evidence: Exact integer/mod-q probes at PROPER dyadic subgroup primes (n=8/16/32/64, q=q^4-ish, n<<sqrt q): scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C044_product_vs_sum.py, probe_C044_full_lacbad.py, probe_C044_sum_identity.py. TWO independent refutations of C044's two load-bearing claims. (1) PRODUCT FORMULA FALSE. C044 asserts the bad scalar at the smallest live gap t=2^L is gamma=+-prod_i x_i^{2^L}*(unit) (a PRODUCT of coset-class values). The exact algebra of loc_coset_union (TopDirectionLineCount.lean): loc(S)=prod_i(X^d - c_i)=prod(Y-c_i), Y=X^d, c_i=x_i^{2^L}; the coeff of X^{|S|-2^L}=coeff of Y^{m-1}=-e1(c)=-SUM_i c_i. So e_t(S)=(-1)^{d-1}*SUM_i x_i^{2^L} (a SUM, = e_1 of the class set), NOT the product (=e_m, which only appears at the TOP gap t=|S|). probe_C044_sum_identity.py confirms e_t == (-1)^{d-1}*SUM exactly in EVERY case (match=True for n=16/32/64); the claimed PRODUCT matches only coincidentally (one m=3 row where SUM==PROD). probe_C044_product_vs_sum.py Part 1: e_t==SUM True in all 14 cases, e_t==PROD False except coincidences. (2) CARDINALITY BOUND FALSE. Full enumeration of the ENTIRE vanishing variety {S subset mu_n : |S|=a, e_1=...=e_{t-1}=0} -> #lacBad = #distinct e_t: at (n=16,a=4,t=2) #lacBad=25 > 16=n (bound n/gcd=8); at (n=16,a=6,t=2) #lacBad=40 > 16=n. Both EXCEED n, refuting #lacBad<=n/gcd(t,n)<=n. lacBad IS coset-closed (lacBad_smul_closed genuinely holds) but occupies MANY cosets of mu_{n/d} (e.g. {0} union 3 cosets of size 8 = 25), not one orbit / O(1) cosets. Because e_t is a varying SUM of m class-values, distinct m-subsets of mu_{n/d} give distinct subset-sums => #lacBad grows past n. The in-tree card_vanishingEsymm_subsets_eq (=n/h) only applies at the TOP gap h=a=t (agreement = subgroup order), NOT at the smallest live gap with a>t (coset unions), where C044 misapplies it.
honest_note: Refutation is of C044's specific structural mechanism (product => single orbit => #lacBad<=n), not of the underlying lemmas, which are correct: loc_coset_union, esymmF_image_mul, lacBad_smul_closed are all genuine and axiom-clean. The coset-quantization (lacBad = union of mu_{n/gcd} cosets) is TRUE; what is false is that there are O(1) such cosets / that the value is a single product. The TRUE floor question -- whether the FULL lacBad over all window-interior directions stays O(n) (i.e. O(1) cosets) -- is left exactly where it was: it reduces to subset-sum equidistribution of the class set in mu_{n/d}, which is the BGK/Paley sup-norm wall (the e_t SUM is a partial Gauss-period-type sum), not a constructive product bound. So C044 does not constructively explain #bad=Theta(n) and does not bound it by n. Probes are small (n<=64) but exact and structural (the SUM-not-PRODUCT identity is a closed-form algebraic fact from loc_coset_union, holding for all q,n); the n-exceeding counts at n=16 are exact full enumerations. This belongs in DISPROOF_LOG.
wall: BGK / generalized-Paley sup-norm (subset-sum / Gauss-period equidistribution of the class set in mu_{n/d}): the smallest-live-gap bad scalar is the SUM e_1({x_i^{2^L}}), so bounding #distinct values is the incomplete-character-sum problem, not a product collapse.
